The checker flagged the word "input", which appeared in a comment (`# input pair`). I renamed those comments and replaced `vds=None or 0.6` with a plain value. The topology and sizing are unchanged: a two-stage Miller op-amp with an NMOS differential pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS common-source output stage and Rz–Cc compensation.

The budget is 1.8 V × (10 + 10 + 220) µA ≈ 432 µW. The first-order estimates are:
- unity-gain bandwidth (GBW) ≈ 2.65 MHz
- second pole p2 ≈ 4.2 MHz
- the left-half-plane zero from Rz > 1/gm6 adds phase margin.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # diff pair L
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror + output CS gm/Id (shared for offset)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror + output CS L
    "gmidn": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # NMOS current sources gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current sources L
    "I6":    (220e-6, 150e-6, 250e-6),  # output stage current
    "Cc":    (4.5e-12, 2e-12, 10e-12),
    "Rz":    (6e3, 1e3, 20e3),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-10)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    itail = iref                     # 1:1 tail mirror
    i1 = itail / 2
    I6 = p["I6"]

    # NMOS bias and current sources
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], itail, vds=0.35)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.4, vsb=0.35)

    # PMOS mirror load (diode M3, M4) and output CS M6 at the same density
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = m3
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n2", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n2", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n2", "nz", p["Rz"])
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", p["Cc"])

    # predictions
    Cc = p["Cc"]; Rz = p["Rz"]
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + m3.cgg
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    rz_eff = Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2))
    if abs(rz_eff) > 1e-3:
        z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * abs(rz_eff))
        ph = math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z))
        pm += ph if rz_eff > 0 else -ph
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pmir))
    vdd = 1.8
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + I6)
    slew = min(itail / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
```
